status: authored 2026-09-18; the Mt Clay outflow only
purpose: Named rivers and creeks that carry a roster of their own. A waterway is a centreline with a half width, not a polygon: the spawn boxes follow it, and the entries scoped to it carry neededNearbyBlocks water so the spawns stay at the water's edge and the banks stay forest.
note: A habitat block is the wrong tool for a river. It is a sphere: covering the Mt Clay outflow at range 48 would take about fourteen blocks, each turning a 96-block-wide disc of forest into river country for the creek's whole length.
exclusion: tools/compile_spawns.py cuts a waterway's cells out of the sub-region boxes around it, the same way it cuts out the route corridors. Without that the forest roster spawns at the water's edge too and dilutes the river: measured at the creek head on 2026-09-18, Wooper and Quagsire were 2 of 28 spawns within 64 blocks, against foothill_woods at 21-23.

waterways.character: The creek that leaves the pond west of Mt Clay at its south-west corner and runs 1,300 blocks down to the western lake, losing fifty blocks of height on the way. Wooper country: thick where it leaves the pond, thinning as the water widens and cools downstream.

habitat_fixes.wooper paldean: OWNER-DECIDED 2026-10-09 ("the wooper creek should spawn the paldean versions"): the creek's Wooper is the Paldean form, common, 24-30, weight 24, at the water's edge (data/spawns.json surface.mt_clay_outflow.wooper_paldean). It REPLACES plain Wooper rather than sitting beside it: two forms in one common bucket would split the weight and blur the creek's identity, the owner asked for the Paldean versions, and Paldean Wooper (Poison/Ground, jar Paldea form) is still an Electric-immune Ground answer for Route 3 through its Ground typing. Plain Wooper keeps its other places (Marshy Marsh basin, Lake Viltri Hollow) and Quagsire stays on the creek at uncommon, unchanged (Quagsire evolves from plain Wooper only, so it is a standalone resident here). Climate: Paldean Wooper is native only to is_savanna / is_arid and mud in the 1.8.0 jar and the creek is cool/temperate, so tools/spawn_habitat_audit.py rules it with OWNER_DECIDED, a per-(place, species) exception; no climate rule was widened
habitat_fixes.clodsire: OWNER-DECIDED 2026-10-09 ("clodsire should be in wooper creek as well"): Clodsire, rare, level 24-30, weight 2, at the water's edge along the whole course (data/spawns.json surface.mt_clay_outflow.clodsire). Verified in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar: Wooper's Paldea form evolves to clodsire by level_up at minLevel 20, below the band's floor of 24. Rare because it is the Paldean line's adult (the creek's other adults are uncommon, Quagsire and Poliwhirl, and its rarest is Drednaw); same native-climate exception as Paldean Wooper in OWNER_DECIDED. Hummock Mere's level-52 named Clodsire (data/hummock_mere.json) is a separate resident and is untouched

superseded_wooper_paldean_removal.note: kept as history; superseded 2026-10-09 by the owner's decision in 'wooper paldean' and 'clodsire' above. The conclusion (remove, do not replace) no longer stands; the facts it cites (jar nativity, creek climate) are unchanged and are why OWNER_DECIDED exists
superseded_wooper_paldean_removal.wooper paldean: removed from data/spawns.json's hand-authored waterway entries (2026-10-04, the owner's wrong-country sweep; tools/spawn_habitat_audit.py KNOWN): Paldean Wooper is native in the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar only to is_savanna / is_arid and mud (badlands, desert, savanna, mangrove), and the creek runs mostly through foothill_woods (mixed_woods = windswept_forest, cool), two steps away. A biomes condition could hold it to the creek's lower course in north_west_coast (coast_scrub = plains, temperate), but that is still a hot-country frog on a cool coast, one step short of wrong and not right. Removed, not replaced: plain Wooper, native everywhere in the jar, already holds the common bucket at the same weight and levels, so the creek stays Wooper country and Route 3's Electric-immune Ground answer is unchanged
superseded_wooper_paldean_removal.clodsire: removed with Paldean Wooper, its only source, for the same reason (native only to is_savanna / is_arid and mud). Its rare bucket goes empty; Quagsire, uncommon, is the creek's grown Ground/Water answer as before

waterways.half_width_basis: a 16-block strip, nearly all of which is water-adjacent, so cutting it out of the sub-region rosters leaves no dead forest behind. At the 24 it was first authored with, the strip was 48 wide and its outer thirds carried nothing.
waterways.traced_from: the staging export cobblers-dryrun, 2026-09-17: the connected water body that touches the pond's south-west corner, sampled every 40 blocks of x along its centre. The pond itself (x 1987-2212, z 1621-1793, y 119) is a separate body and keeps its default spawns.
